**Director & Shareholder:** The firm has **5 directors** and **4 shareholders**. The largest shareholder is **Director 1** with **50.59%** of the equity.  

**Financials:** Using the most recent FY 2024 (ended 30 Jun 2024), revenue fell to **RM2.08m**, a **‑7.4%** YoY decline from FY 2023. Gross profit margin stands at **52.0%**, while operating profit margin is **‑11.2%**, indicating loss‑making operations. Free cash flow is **RM‑205.75k** and net debt (borrowings ‑ cash) amounts to **RM659.21k**, reflecting a cash‑negative position and considerable leverage.  

**Litigation:** Two court cases are recorded. One defendant case (Debt recovery, dismissed) with a claim of **RM106.90k**, and one plaintiff case (Debt recovery, settled) with a claim of **RM519.80k**.  

**Review Rating:** **2/5 – Low review priority**. The company shows declining revenue, negative operating margins, negative free cash flow and a sizable net‑debt burden, outweighing the modest litigation exposure.
